title: CAFIN: CUDA-accelerated Adaptive Fisher Information Matrix Network Optimization via GPU-Native Kernel Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.14589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Second-order optimizers improve deep neural network training using curvature information, but their practical efficiency is limited by GPU execution overhead. AdaFisher reduces Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) approximation costs through diagonal Kronecker structures and exponential moving averages, yet its PyTorch implementation requires sequential CUDA kernel launches, intermediate tensor allocations, and repeated memory accesses. We introduce CAFIN, a GPU-native CUDA kernel fusion framework that improves AdaFisher execution efficiency without changing its optimization formulation. The proposed approach progressively integrates FIM preconditioner construction, exponential moving average updates, gradient preconditioning, momentum accumulation, weight decay, and parameter updates into fused CUDA kernels. Shared-memory reuse, register-resident computation, and in-place operations further reduce memory traffic and intermediate allocation

translated_title: CAFIN：通过GPU原生算子融合实现CUDA加速的自适应费舍尔信息矩阵网络优化
translated_abstract: 二阶优化器利用曲率信息来改进深度神经网络的训练，但其实际效率受到GPU执行开销的限制。AdaFisher通过对角Kronecker结构和指数移动平均降低了费舍尔信息矩阵（FIM）近似的成本，但其PyTorch实现需要顺序的CUDA核函数启动、中间张量分配以及重复的内存访问。我们提出了CAFIN，一个GPU原生的CUDA算子融合框架，能够在不改变其优化公式的前提下提升AdaFisher的执行效率。该方法将FIM预条件子构建、指数移动平均更新、梯度预条件处理、动量累积、权重衰减和参数更新逐步集成到融合的CUDA核函数中。共享内存复用、寄存器驻留计算和原地操作进一步减少了内存流量和中间分配开销。
tldr: CAFIN提出了一种GPU原生的CUDA算子融合框架，将AdaFisher二阶优化器的各计算步骤（如FIM预条件子构建、动量更新、权重衰减等）融合为单个CUDA核函数，并借助共享内存复用与原地操作，在不改变优化算法公式的前提下显著提升了执行效率。
